prompts.name: logo-horizontal
prompts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Use the attached image as the approved Prep Sheet logo reference. Preserve its distinctive upright rounded recipe sheet with a chef knife integrated into the right edge, handle above the sheet, and two horizontal recipe lines. This is a cohesive branding family for the existing Prep Sheet cooking/recipe organisation app. Adapt the plum to exact forest ink #283e32, cream #faf7ef, leaf green #527b42 and restrained orange #ee8a4b. Current app type is Nunito, rounded friendly sans serif, weight 900. Replace the original serif with rounded Nunito-like lettering. Flat solid fills, crisp edges, no gradients, shadows, textures, mockup scenes, watermarks, captions or extra logos. Tasteful, warm, simple. Create a single horizontal logo lockup, landscape canvas approximately 3:1. At left the approved recipe-and-knife symbol in forest ink with the two orange bullet dots; to its right exact text "Prep Sheet" in forest ink rounded Nunito-style extra-bold lettering. Carefully balance icon and wordmark with ample clear space. Genuine transparent background. No miniature logo repeats, no presentation board.
